incidents.summary: Black former employees sued Rotork Controls Inc., alleging that compliance with federal anti-DEI demands resulted in their terminations.

sources.title: Worker Bias Suits Reveal DEI Dual Compliance Trap for Employers
sources.quote:
Employment attorneys said recent lawsuits by Black ex-employees alleging 

International Business Machines Corp.'s

Rotork Controls Inc.‘s

 compliance with federal anti-DEI demands resulted in their terminations underscore this precarious environment.

positives: SBTi validated Rotork's near-term greenhouse gas emissions reduction targets as conforming to its criteria and recommendations.
